grades: Rising juniors and seniors (current 10th or 11th graders)
name: Summer Residential Governor's School for Medicine and Health Sciences
org: Radford University and Blue Ridge Partnership for Health Science Careers, with Carilion Clinic
what_you_do: About three weeks of hands-on healthcare learning: visit healthcare providers, health education institutions and research labs, practice CPR, work at a free clinic, and meet faculty and students.
who_can_apply: Rising juniors and seniors (current 10th or 11th graders) enrolled in Virginia high schools who are interested in health careers. 20 students took part in 2026.
pay_detail: $300 activity fee for outings and enrichment. Hardship waiver available. Tuition not stated on the pages read.
duration: About 3 weeks, late June to early July in 2026
deadline_text: 2027 dates and deadline not found on the pages read. Ask your school counselor.
how_to_apply: The application starts at the local school district level. Forms are on the Virginia Department of Education Summer Residential Governor's School page.
notes: Held in Roanoke, not in Blacksburg. Email MHSgovschool@radford.edu. The Virginia Department of Education page blocked our reader, so check it for current dates.
